About this item

  • TRENDY DESIGNER STYLE:Embrace timeless charm with our round-frame sunglasses! Inspired by classic retro styles,they blend vintage flair with modern elegance.The sleek, rounded shape flatters all face types,adding a stylish touch to any outfit, from casual to dressy
  • HD POLARIZED LENSE:Say goodbye to annoying glare! Our polarized sunglasses womens feature premium polarized lenses that cut through harsh light from roads,water,and snow.They let you see clearly while reducing eye strain,making every outdoor moment more comfortable and enjoyable
  • RELIABLE UV PROTECTION:Shield your eyes from harmful sun rays! These sunglasses womens provide reliable UV protection,blocking the sun’s damaging ultraviolet light.Whether you’re out for hours or just a quick trip,your eyes stay safe and protected all day long
  • COMFORTABLE and LIGHTWEIGHT FRAME:Experience all-day comfort with our metal frame vintage sunglasses!Lightweight yet durable,they feature sturdy metal hinges and one-piece nose pads.You’ll forget you’re wearing them—no more pressure on your nose or messed-up hair,even after hours of use.
  • VERSATILE for ANY OCCASION:Your go-to trendy sunglasses for every adventure! Perfect for beach vacations,driving,sports,festivals,cycling,fishing,skiing,and hiking.They handle any outdoor activity,keeping you stylish and protected wherever your day takes you

Product Description

Looking for sunglasses that mix style, comfort, and protection? Our Women's Polarized Retro Round Sunglasses are exactly what you need! The polarized lenses reduce glare troubles—great for driving on sunny days or traveling—while reliable UV protection keeps your eyes safe. The retro round frame adds a vintage touch to any outfit, and the lightweight TR90 metal frame with one-piece nose pads ensures you can wear them all day without discomfort. Whether you’re heading to the beach, hitting the trails, or just running, these sunglasses are your go-to. They’re not just an accessory—they’re a daily essential that works for every moment.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Updated. Skeptical based on packaging, but…
There was one small box inside the outer packaging. I thought maybe only one pair was sent. I was wrong! All three were inside the box. The frames are larger than I typically wear, but I think they will provide better coverage. Great value for 3 pair of sunglasses. Only time will tell how they feel after wearing them for hours and how well they hold up. I look forward to testing them out on our trip to Alaska. Update - they do tend to squeeze my head after wearing them for a few hours. Will have to wear them for shorter periods of time. I thought the thinner ear pieces might not do that, but they do. Still good glasses for the price!

    Reviewed in Canada on April 11, 2026

    These came as a set of three and the colors are all different, so you are not stuck with three pairs that look identical. I will be honest, I do not particularly love this round retro style on myself, it is just not my usual look. But here is the good part, I was actually able to give one pair to my husband and it did not look feminine at all. The frame shape works on pretty much anyone, which was a nice surprise. The gold metal arms and the overall build feel sturdy enough for the price point, and they are not flimsy or cheap feeling.

    The lenses are polarized with UV protection so they actually do the job of cutting glare and blocking the sun. They have ergonomic nose pads and curved temple tips so they stay put without sliding down your face, which is a problem I have had with cheaper sunglasses before. They are lightweight too, so you can wear them for a while without your ears hurting. If you like the round retro look, you will probably love these. And if you do not, you might still find someone in your house who will wear them, which is basically what happened to me.

    The product matches the description perfectly. I wasn’t expecting sunglasses of this quality. The frames are solid and the materials feel premium—actually better than some frames sold by opticians!

    The dimensions fit me perfectly, and I didn’t need to make any adjustments. I really like the shape—it’s exactly the style that was very popular in the 1980s. The lenses are polarized and work very well, reducing glare effectively.

    Overall, I’m extremely satisfied with these sunglasses and would highly recommend them for anyone looking for stylish, high-quality eyewear.

Product Description

Looking for sunglasses that mix style, comfort, and protection? Our Women's Polarized Retro Round Sunglasses are exactly what you need! The polarized lenses reduce glare troubles—great for driving on sunny days or traveling—while reliable UV protection keeps your eyes safe. The retro round frame adds a vintage touch to any outfit, and the lightweight TR90 metal frame with one-piece nose pads ensures you can wear them all day without discomfort. Whether you’re heading to the beach, hitting the trails, or just running, these sunglasses are your go-to. They’re not just an accessory—they’re a daily essential that works for every moment.
